title: Lesson 3｜Task 2 结构 + 三七开（同意/利弊）
summary: 大作文常见类型与文章结构；三七开策略用于同意与否、利弊对比。提供 6.5 级模板与改写/翻译式练习。

parts.title: Task 2 常见类型与通用结构
keypoints: 常见题型：同意与否（agree/disagree）；利弊对比（advantages/disadvantages）；双边讨论；报告类等
建议结构：引言（改写题干+立场）→ 主体一（理由1+解释+例子）→ 主体二（理由2+解释+例子/让步）→ 结论（重申立场+总括）
句长与词汇：力求清晰可读，避免过度复杂与生僻词；连接自然
评分要点：任务回应到位；结构清晰；词句多样但准确；衔接自然

parts.title: 三七开策略（同意/利弊）
keypoints: 同意与否：一方为主（70%），另一方为辅（30% 的让步/反面观点）
利弊对比：可选“利为主、弊为辅”或“弊为主、利为辅”，保持态度明确
段内组织：主题句→解释→例子/结果→小结；次要一方点到为止
结论：不引入新观点，简短重申即可

parts.title: 6.5 级常用模板与用语
keypoints: 引言：In my view/From my perspective, I (agree/disagree) that ...；While there are (benefits/drawbacks), I believe ...
主体理由：One main reason is that ...；This is because ...；For example, ...；As a result, ...
让步/反方：However/Nevertheless, it is also true that ...；It can be argued that ...
结论：In conclusion, although ... , I still believe that ...；To sum up, ...

exercises.title: 同意与否：引言+主体骨架（三七开）
exercises.instruction: 根据提示，完成引言与主体的关键短语（6.5 级）。空格聚焦时显示对应模板提示。

items.text: that online learning can effectively support higher education.
Thesis: While there are certain drawbacks, I

items.answer: believe the benefits outweigh the downsides

items.text: students can access high-quality courses anywhere.
, recorded lectures allow flexible review after class.
, simple schedules and reminders can help.
, although there are downsides, I still believe that online learning is a valuable part of modern education.

exercises.title: 利大于弊：段内展开（三七开：利为主）
exercises.instruction: 补全连接与解释用语，保持逻辑清晰、句式简洁。

items.text: , public transport reduces traffic and pollution.
fewer cars are used by individuals.
, in many cities, bus lanes speed up commuting and save fuel.
, public transport can be crowded at peak hours;
, better timetables can ease the problem.
, the benefits of public transport clearly outweigh the drawbacks.

exercises.title: 翻译式短句（引言/主体/结论常用块）
exercises.instruction: 将常用中文表达转为自然的 6.5 级英语短句（填关键短语）。

items.text: basic budgeting helps teenagers plan spending.
, they can compare prices and avoid impulse buying.
, financial education is necessary for students.

tips.title: 引言（改写题干 + 明确立场）
tips.content: In my view/From my perspective, I (agree/disagree) that ...；避免重复题干原词，可做同义替换或结构转换。

tips.title: 论点展开（主题句→解释→例子→小结）
tips.content: One main reason is that ...；This is because ...；For example, ...；As a result, ...；段落聚焦一个主旨，避免面面俱到。

tips.title: 三七开：主次分明 + 让步简洁
tips.content: 主观点约 70% 篇幅；让步 30% 点到为止：However/Nevertheless, it is also true that ...；然后迅速回到主线。

tips.title: 结论（不引入新观点）
tips.content: In conclusion/To sum up, ...；重申立场与主旨，不展开新论点或数据。
